These six fixtures derive from the pinned managed downloaders in Ameow #23's
first-round CLI fault validation (2026-11-06). The task-owned proxy rejected
CONNECT or was unavailable. No production system proxy setting was changed.

Object identifiers, endpoint hosts/ports, memory addresses and report URLs are
replaced by synthetic placeholders. Native exception wording, line prefixes,
machine error records and CR/CRLF endings are retained. Original samples remain
private and unchanged. The local second-round fixture-provenance receipt records
both original and sanitized hashes. These fixtures prove parser behavior, not a
fresh native network test or TUN/PAC compatibility.
